[VOICEOVER]: A family gathering in a modest Filipino home. The air thick with unspoken words.

[DIALOGUE]: Aling Nena: "Anak, kailangan mo na yang pera para sa school supplies ni Mia?" Kiko: "Ay nako, tatay, wala na akong pambili. Hindi ko alam kung paano ko sasabihin 'to."
